name: welcome-tour
note: S-WELCOME v2 (UAT 2026-08-09, supersedes the 3-panel tour): orientation is ONE panel - instrument pick (guitar-standard preselected) + the promise that Start playing ends in a jam. Finishing sets the music.welcomeJam.v1 intent flag; the fresh-device path RELOADS into the chosen instrument (?p=guitar-standard), where tracksCtl onReady consumes the flag and opens the FEATURED jam's Studio honestly unstarted (a load is not a gesture - one tap starts sound). The library callout defers to the Studio's first leave so its show-once is never burned under the sheet. Landing is JAMS-first (segJams default, featured jam pinned to row 1). Settings replay copy is timeless (no panel-count). 'firstRun': true opts OUT of the runner's welcomeDone seeding - every other scenario models a returning user. Keeps the appbar-chrome, Preferences-first, About-last, and setlist scroll-model asserts from v1.

steps.label: a fresh device is greeted by the first-run tour (overlay up, app booted behind it)
the tour is ONE panel, CTA is Start playing immediately, and it FITS: no vertical scroll at 412x915 (round-4 goalpost - prose trimmed + cigar box removed)
guitar-standard is preselected, and Cigar Box is GONE from the instrument list (round 4: removed everywhere)
the panel PROMISES the jam: Start playing is named and a backing track is the payoff
the appbar is clean chrome: brand + offline pill + gear - NO instrument picker in the always-on bar

the tour ends IN A JAM: post-reload the 'welcome'-tagged ORIGINAL jam's Studio is open (ad-free reggae, not the Content-ID-claimed Phish video), flag consumed, guitar-standard landed, tour done for good
the library callout has NOT fired under the sheet (show-once preserved for the Studio's first leave)
leaving the Studio for the first time fires the DEFERRED library callout (one-shot, now visible over the list)

the landing is JAMS-first with the pin order welcome > featured: Jams is the FIRST segment and active, the reggae welcome jam is row 1 and Harry Hood row 2 (round 5: 'put the reggae track as first in the list')
steps.js: (function(){var j=document.getElementById('segJams'),a=document.getElementById('segAll');if(!j||!a)return false;if(!j.classList.contains('on')||a.classList.contains('on'))return false;if(!(j.compareDocumentPosition(a)&Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING))return false;var t=document.querySelectorAll('#songsList .listItem .li-title');if(t.length<2)return false;return /reggae backing track/i.test(t[0].textContent) && /harry hood/i.test(t[1].textContent);})()

steps.label: the Settings replay row is TIMELESS copy - it names the welcome intro, never a panel count
Preferences is the FIRST Settings section and owns the relocated instrument picker (populated, out of the appbar)
About stays the LAST section (rarely-needed content sinks to the bottom)
setlist keeps the Library scroll model (head static, no h2, #setBody the only scroller)
